step1_analysis.description: A time-multiplexed switching converter that generates two independent output voltages using a single shared inductor. It operates in Discontinuous Conduction Mode (DCM) to minimize cross-regulation between the outputs.

paper_reference.title: Single-Inductor Multiple-Output Switching Converters With Time-Multiplexing Control in Discontinuous Conduction Mode

sky130_expected.calculation: Pout / Pin * 100. With Vg=1.8V, Ipk=0.64A, Pin=230mW, Pout=205mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on switch ON-resistance and diode forward voltage drop. Expected to be similar to the paper's reported value.

output_power.description: Total power delivered to both loads

sky130_expected.reasoning: Scales with input voltage and chosen inductor/frequency. Tuned to ~200mW for a 1.8V input in this testbench.

voa_avg.description: Average output voltage of channel A

sky130_expected.reasoning: The provided netlist topology is an inverting buck-boost, so the outputs are negative. Magnitude depends on duty cycle and load.

voa_ripple.description: Peak-to-peak voltage ripple on channel A

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by output capacitor size, load current, and switching frequency.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure steady-state output voltages, ripple, power, and efficiency of the SIDO converter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* SIMO Converter Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Switch and Diode models for DCM operation
.model switch_model SW(vt=0.5 vh=0.1 ron=0.2 roff=1Meg)
.model Dideal D(Is=1e-12 Rs=0.1 N=1)

.subckt switch_ideal n1 n2 ctrl
S1 n1 n2 ctrl 0 switch_model
.ends

.subckt switch_ideal_out n1 n2 ctrl
S1 n_mid n1 ctrl 0 switch_model
D1 n2 n_mid Dideal
.ends

* Input Source
V1 Vg 0 dc 1.8

* Original netlist adapted for ngspice syntax and DCM operation
X1 Vg N1 ctrl1 switch_ideal
L1 N1 0 1u
Xa N1 Voa ctrla switch_ideal_out
Xb N1 Vob ctrlb switch_ideal_out
Coa Voa 0 10u
Roa Voa 0 50
Cob Vob 0 10u
Rob Vob 0 50

* Control signals for Time-Multiplexing (1MHz per channel -> 2us total period)
Vctrl1 ctrl1 0 PULSE(0 1 0 1n 1n 0.4u 1u)
Vctrla ctrla 0 PULSE(0 1 0.4u 1n 1n 0.5u 2u)
Vctrlb ctrlb 0 PULSE(0 1 1.4u 1n 1n 0.5u 2u)

.control
tran 10n 200u

* Measure steady-state averages and ripples over the last 10us
meas tran Voa_avg avg v(Voa) from=190u to=200u
meas tran Vob_avg avg v(Vob) from=190u to=200u
meas tran Voa_max max v(Voa) from=190u to=200u
meas tran Voa_min min v(Voa) from=190u to=200u
meas tran Vob_max max v(Vob) from=190u to=200u
meas tran Vob_min min v(Vob) from=190u to=200u
meas tran Iin_avg avg i(V1) from=190u to=200u

* Calculate metrics
let Voa_ripple = Voa_max - Voa_min
let Vob_ripple = Vob_max - Vob_min
let Pin = -1.8 * Iin_avg
let Pout_a = (Voa_avg * Voa_avg) / 50
let Pout_b = (Vob_avg * Vob_avg) / 50
let Pout = Pout_a + Pout_b
let efficiency = Pout / Pin * 100

print Voa_avg Vob_avg Voa_ripple Vob_ripple Pin Pout efficiency
quit
.endc
.end
